symptom: Repair v20 passed the static candidate chain, GameCore validate-content, and isolated validate-candidates, but failed the formal 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. Idle 0.0%, Random 0.0%, Greedy 33.3%, Kite 66.7%, Tank 33.3%, BossHunter 66.7%, ZoneControl 33.3%, and Route 33.3% stayed inside their target bands, while Coward dropped to 0.0% against a required 10%-35% low-skill target.
root_cause: Returning to the v18 baseline and moving an additional 0.01 of sandwich-cookie-creep weight into sprinkle-spitter ranged pressure repaired Greedy and Route on the first three seeds, but it also removed too much readable slow-blocker recovery space from Coward. The 210-300 second window became just harsh enough that low-skill survival lost its single required recovery win, so broad or direct ranged-pressure increases are no longer safe.
fix: Do not promote v20 or run the 10-seed expansion. Create v21 as a generated candidate only, starting from v18 or a v20-adjacent baseline, and avoid further simple sugar-moth or sprinkle-spitter pressure increases. The next repair should preserve Coward's lower-bound survival while reducing Greedy / Kite / Route seed expansion overperformance through narrower buildcraft, economy, or timing changes.
validation: Rerun the candidate static chain, then rerun the same 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. A viable v21 must keep Coward and Route between 10%-35%, Greedy / Tank / ZoneControl between 25%-55%, Kite / BossHunter between 45%-75%, and Idle / Random inside their floor bands before any 10-seed expansion, Replay regression, or human review.
